answer: The design leans on quadratic conviction weighting that decays rapidly under synchronized voting patterns. Each submission hangs on the jade of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wander of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
